us.title: Florida puts 77-year-old man to death, carrying out its 18th execution of the year
us.desc: Last year, Florida set a state record with 19 executions in a year, and it's poised to tie that mark if another execution is carried out next month as scheduled.

us.title: Cornell responds to Jane Doe letter saying she felt disbelieved
us.desc: Cornell has denied claims made in a letter from a former student, known as Jane Doe, about a remark by the school's president.
